sections.content: You know *creo que* and *me parece que* from B1 Unit 7. Here you add *considero que* and *desde mi punto de vista*, and you connect the opinion to a reason with *porque* or *aunque* instead of leaving it as an isolated statement.

items.spanish: Creo que esta propuesta es útil porque responde a un problema real.
items.english: I think this proposal is useful because it responds to a real problem.

items.spanish: Desde mi punto de vista, la medida debería cambiar, porque afecta a muchas personas.
items.english: From my point of view, the measure should change, because it affects many people.

items.spanish: Me parece que esta postura es razonable, aunque necesita más evidencia.
items.english: It seems to me that this position is reasonable, although it needs more evidence.

items.spanish: Considero que debemos escuchar otros puntos de vista antes de decidir.
items.english: I consider that we should listen to other points of view before deciding.

sections.content: Remember: *me parece que* means “it seems to me”, not “I seem”. Like *creo que*, it takes the indicative, because neither one doubts or denies the claim.
